settings.title: Settings
settings.troubleshooting_desc: Something wrong? Use these options below to attempt to fix the issues you're experiencing.
settings.cache_method_dynamic_desc: Merges packages into separate set folders under Mods/Cache. Allows fast, incremental configuration changes.
settings.cache_method_static_desc: Merges all active packages into a single folder. Ideal for users with many small sets. Changing configurations requires a cache rebuild.
settings.compression_desc: Higher compression levels may save disk space but take significantly longer to rebuild cache. Low compression provides the best balance of loading speed and fast rebuilds.
settings.migration_desc: Migrate your legacy CC Magic setup to PlumbobForge. This will move all your files into your library, but not Sets or Configurations.
settings.auto_import_desc: PlumbobForge monitors your specified observed folders and automatically imports new CC packages. You can toggle auto-scanning or trigger a manual import below.
settings.observed_folders_desc: Configure custom folders to monitor. When custom folders are configured, PlumbobForge will monitor them exclusively instead of the default Downloads folder.
settings.default_observed_folder_hint: No custom observed folders added. Defaulting to standard Sims 3 Downloads folder.
settings.doc_dir_desc: Location of your main PlumbobForge folder. It's where PlumbobForge will automatically manage your library.
settings.game_dir_desc: Location of where your copy of The Sims 3 is installed. It's required to properly sync certain packages.
settings.migrate_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to migrate files from CC Magic? This will move all your files into your PlumbobForge Library.
settings.migrate_success: Successfully migrated {count} files to PlumbobForge Library.

settings.recheck_confirm_msg: This will scan all items in your library to verify their package types. Do you want to proceed?
settings.autofix_confirm_msg: This will check for missing sets, unassigned items, and perform a full cache rebuild. Do you want to proceed?

modal.duplicate_action_replace_desc: Overwrites existing files in your library with the newly imported files.

walkthrough.welcome_subtitle: Your new CC manager, designed to help you effortlessly manage custom content and more for The Sims 3.
walkthrough.what_does_it_do_desc: PlumbobForge helps you organize, manage, and automatically merge your CC. By grouping your packages together, it can improve loading times in The Sims 3.
walkthrough.script_mods_warning: Warning: Only standard custom content (like clothes, hair, and furniture), sims, lots, and worlds should be imported. Do not import script mods, merging them will break their functionality!
walkthrough.content_manager_desc: This is where you organize your files into Sets. You can drag and drop CC, use search and filters, and browse. Sets can be nested inside one another for deeper organization.
walkthrough.configurations_desc: Configurations allow you to choose exactly which Sets are enabled or disabled for a given playthrough. You can create different Configurations for different saves, and instantly switch between them without touching your files.
walkthrough.game_dir_desc: Please select the directory where The Sims 3 is installed. It's needed to properly handle certain files.
walkthrough.game_dir_invalid_error: Could not detect game files in this directory.
walkthrough.migrate_desc: Are you moving from CC Magic? PlumbobForge can automatically copy all your files into your new library.
walkthrough.migrate_warning: Warning: This only moves your files, not your legacy Sets or Configurations. You will need to manually organize your content again in PlumbobForge.
walkthrough.wip_desc1: PlumbobForge is still in early development. You may encounter bugs or missing features!
walkthrough.wip_desc2: If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please reach out to me on Tumblr or Reddit.
